mediaWork.title: Picking Cotton: Our Memoir of Injustice and Redemption
mediaWork.creatorName: Jennifer Thompson-Cannino, Ronald Cotton, with Erin Torneo
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Eyewitness misidentification, wrongful conviction, forgiveness, and reconciliation
mediaWork.summaryNotes: This memoir offers a dual perspective on a wrongful conviction case, detailing the experience of both the wrongfully convicted individual, Ronald Cotton, and the victim who misidentified him, Jennifer Thompson-Cannino. It explores the impact of eyewitness misidentification, the exoneration process through DNA evidence, and the subsequent reconciliation between the two individuals.  The book highlights systemic issues within the criminal justice system and offers policy recommendations for reform.
